item.title: How We Finally Fixed Our Tiny Bathroom (Without Losing Our Minds)
item.description:
Right, let me tell you—if you’ve ever lived in a standard British flat, you know the pain of the “shoebox bathroom.” Ours was, quite frankly, a bit of a nightmare. It measured about 1.8 metres by 2.2 metres, and honestly, you couldn’t swing a cat in there without hitting the towel rail or knocking over a shampoo bottle.

For three years, I lived with a bathroom that felt like it was shrinking every time I walked in. Every surface was cluttered, the tiles were a questionable shade of 90s cream, and the storage situation? Let’s just say my skincare routine was mostly living in a plastic crate on the floor. It was a proper faff just to find a clean towel without creating an avalanche of toiletries.

item.title: How I Finally Stopped Working from My Sofa (And Other Tiny Living Miracles)
item.description:
I’ll be honest with you: living in a small flat is basically a never-ending game of Tetris, except the blocks are your belongings and the stakes involve losing your sanity.

For the longest time, my main living space—a measly 15-square-metre box—was doing absolutely everything. I was eating lukewarm pasta on a laptop stand while sitting on the same sofa I used to watch Netflix on, all while surrounded by a pile of work paperwork that mocked me from the coffee table. It was, quite frankly, a bit of a nightmare.
